metadata.name: CreditBalanceRefundFailed
metadata.description: This webhook is triggered when a credit balance refund  transaction is failed on account.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description:
Account Number associated with the event. The Account Number is consistently maintained at the Account level (one-to-one Mapping).
Valid Values: 0-9
Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description:
Admin Number associated with the event. Admin Number is always associated with a Card (Can be Primary or Secondary)
Valid Values:0-9
Format:XXXXX
Example:12345

request_fields.name: RequestID
request_fields.description: Primary Key for API Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: Mode
request_fields.description: Indicates the type of activity performed which triggered this webhook Possible Value: Alert, Insert, Transaction Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: AccountUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description:
Universal Unique ID for Account
Format:XXXXXXXXXX
Example:9894f28b-d051-4eaa-9e48-a3a7d5b4a6f7 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: CardUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description:
Card Universal Unique ID
Example: 8638-b87b-48d0-8e13-0ebb5643577
Condition: Will be available if present in request. Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: ClientID
request_fields.description: Corecard’s Client ID Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: RequestUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description:
UniversalUniqueID Request
Example: 8638-b87b-48d0-8e13-0ebb5643577 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: UpdateCallList
request_fields.description: Group of fields passed in webhook

request_fields.name: MonetaryLog
request_fields.description: Group of fields passed in webhook

request_fields.name: Category
request_fields.description: Group of fields passed in webhook

request_fields.name: SubCategory
request_fields.description: Category

request_fields.name: TransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Total amount for which credit was made

request_fields.name: BalanceIndicator
request_fields.description:
Indicates type of balance which is getting impacted by this transaction
Valid Values:Chargeoff Balance,Active Balance(current balance) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: DBIndicator
request_fields.description:
Indicates if this is a debit or credit type of transaction for the account
Valid Values:Credit,Debit Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: BankAccountLast4Digit
request_fields.description:
Bank AccountNumber last 4 digits of account from where funds are credited.
Condition: This field will only be available when refund mode is ACH. Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: ReasonCode
request_fields.description: Return reason code which is sent in an ACH return file. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: CardnumLast4Digits
request_fields.description: Last 4 digits of card number. Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: First name of Account holder Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Last Name of Account holder Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PrimaryEmail
request_fields.description: Email ID of Primary cardholder. This field is available only when AlertRecipientType is 1 or 3 or 5 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerEmailID
request_fields.description: Email ID of Cosigner on account. This field is available only when AlertRecipientType is 2 or 3 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AuthUserEmailID
request_fields.description: Email ID of Secondary cardholder. This field is available only when AlertRecipientType is 4 or 5 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: BankName
request_fields.description: Indicates the Name of the Bank to whose account the credit balance is refunded via ACH. Condition: This field will only be available when refund mode is ACH. Allowable Values: 70

request_fields.name: BankMethodName
request_fields.description:
Unique Identifier for the bank account in CoreCard system.
Condition: This field will only be available when refund mode is ACH. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: RefundType
request_fields.description: Indicates if Credit Balance refund initiation was Automatic or Manual Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RefundMode
request_fields.description:
Indicates the Refund Mode; ACH, Other, Adjust to Loan Account
Condition: Other Refund Mode is when:For Manual Refund Other option is selected. As per Product set up when Automatic transaction posted for credit balance refund. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: PrimaryCurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Primary currency defined for the client at setup. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: AvailableOTB
request_fields.description: Amount available for further purchases on card

request_fields.name: LoanAccountNumber
request_fields.description: Loan account number on which credit balance refund Adjusted Condition: Loan Account number only available when Refund Mode is Adjust to Loan Account. Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: SettlementDate
request_fields.description:
Settlement Date and time of Credit Balance transaction.
(Format: MM/DD/YYYY hhmmss)

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Unique identifier for Transaction ID of Credit made Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: PostingDateTime
request_fields.description:
Date and time when Credit Balance transaction posted. 
(Format: MM/DD/YYYY hhmmss) Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: AlertRecipientType
request_fields.description:
Type of recipient to which alert needs to be sent 
1: - Primary Applicant 
 2: - Cosigner 
3:- Applicant and Cosigner 
4:- Auth User 
5:- Applicant and Auth User

request_fields.name: InfoAlert
request_fields.description: Group of fields passed in webhook

request_fields.name: User
request_fields.description:
API User Id who performed the activity which triggered the event
Valid Values: CoreCredit user, API user, System Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: DateandTime
request_fields.description:
Timestamp when notification was sent
YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss:sss
(24-hour Format)

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description:
Indicates if ACH payment was made from CoreCredit panel or some other source (API)
Valid Values: CoreCredit, API, Self Service, CoreCollect, IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: ServiceName
request_fields.description: Name of API service (webhook) triggered Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: AlertType
request_fields.description:
Indicates type of Alert
Possible Values:RealTime or Re Try (due to time-out) Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: TransactionSource
request_fields.description:
Transaction Source of transaction
Valid Values:IPM, Retail Manual Auth-Installment, Retail Manual Auth-Revolver etc. Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: InstitutionID
request_fields.description: A unique identifier assigned by Corecard for Institution

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: A unique identifier assigned by Corecard for Product

request_fields.name: AlertRecipientType
request_fields.description:
Type of recipient to which alert needs to be sent
Valid Values:1=Primary Applicant,2=Cosigner,3=Applicant and Cosigner,4=Auth User,5=Applicant and Auth User
